physics_goals.quote: MEG II represents a major upgrade designed to improve sensitivity by approximately one order of magnitude, reaching a target branching ratio sensitivity of "6 \times 10^{-14}"
physics_goals.value: Search for the charged-lepton-flavor-violating decay mu+ -> e+ gamma with roughly an order of magnitude better sensitivity than MEG, targeting a branching-ratio sensitivity of 6x10^-14

summary.plain: The upgraded version of MEG at the same Swiss laboratory, hunting for the same forbidden muon decay with about ten times better sensitivity. It has been taking data since 2021 and is still running.
summary.technical: MEG II: upgrade of MEG on the PSI piE5 DC muon beamline, with an upgraded LXe calorimeter, new cylindrical drift chamber, timing counter and radiative decay counter, targeting a branching-ratio sensitivity of 6x10^-14 for mu+ -> e+ gamma. First physics run 2021; a ten-fold larger dataset collected 2022-2023 with data-taking continuing. See result:meg-ii-mu-to-e-gamma-limit-2024 for the first-dataset limit.

unique_capabilities.quote: Liquid Xenon Calorimeter...Cylindrical Drift Chamber...Timing Counter...Target and Radial Drift Chamber (RDC)
unique_capabilities.value: Upgraded liquid xenon calorimeter, cylindrical drift chamber and timing counter, plus a radiative decay counter, on the same PSI piE5 DC muon beamline used by MEG
